# corax_model_pool (Resource)

Manages a Corax Model Pool. A pool load balances requests across several model deployments; capabilities use it through `model_pool_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) Trifork

# Spread traffic 3:1 across two deployments, falling back to the other member
# when one fails.
resource "corax_model_pool" "gpt" {
  name          = "gpt-pool"
  fallback_mode = "try_next"

  # Keyed by model deployment ID. {} takes the defaults
  # (weight = 1, priority = 1, is_active = true).
  members = {
    (corax_model_deployment.primary.id)   = { weight = 3 }
    (corax_model_deployment.secondary.id) = {}
  }
}

resource "corax_completion_capability" "summary" {
  name              = "Summary"
  model_pool_id     = corax_model_pool.gpt.id # mutually exclusive with model_id
  system_prompt     = "You summarize text."
  completion_prompt = "Summarize: {{text}}"
  variables         = ["text"]
  output_type       = "text"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `members` (Attributes Map) The model deployments in the pool, keyed by lower-case model deployment UUID. At least one member is required: a pool without members cannot route. Use `{}` to take the member defaults. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))
- `name` (String) A user-defined name for the model pool.

### Optional

- `cooldown_seconds` (Number) How long a failed member is skipped before it is tried again. Defaults to 60.
- `fallback_mode` (String) What happens when the selected member fails: `try_next` falls back to another member, `fail_fast` returns the error. Defaults to `try_next`.
- `strategy` (String) How requests are distributed across members. Defaults to `weighted_random`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the model pool (UUID).

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Optional:

- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the member receives traffic. Defaults to true.
- `priority` (Number) Member priority. Defaults to 1.
- `weight` (Number) Relative share of traffic for this member. Defaults to 1.
